narr: Thunderstorms resulted in flash flooding over several days, which included Zion National Park.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in Clear Creek within Zion National Park.
Flash flooding was reported in the vicinity of The Narrows in Zion National Park.
The Hildale Dispatch reported two road closures near waterways due to rises from flash flooding.
A flash flood on Short Creek in Hildale flooded a home.
Flash flooding was reported in Clear Creek, Pine Creek, and Spry Canyon in Zion National Park.
The North Fork Virgin - Springdale, Nr gauge rose from near 50 cfs. to 1160 cfs. A corresponding rise over 3 ft. was recorded on the gauge height.
Social media videos showed flash flooding over roads in and near Hildale.
Flash flooding was reported along Pine Creek near the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel.

Flows increased on the North Fork of the Virgin River in Zion National Park. The trail became impassable near the mouth of The Narrows. Flood waters in The Narrows swept some hikers off their feet and isolated others on higher ground. Two people were swept downstream. One was swept a couple of hundred yards and found. The individual survived with minor injuries. The other was reported as missing to Zion National Park officials later that evening, and was found deceased the following Monday. The North Fork Virgin - Springdale river gauge, which is downstream from The Narrows, rose from approximately 75 cfs to 735 cfs, corresponding to a rise of slightly over 2 feet in height.
